boundary: A nonzero map below the center requires a chosen split subgroup and an explicit compatible lift. Dimension matching or quotient-level S4 notation is insufficient; no canonical proper-subgroup map is claimed.

central_character_obstruction.stronger_statement: The same vanishing holds for every subgroup of 2.U4(2) containing the central involution.

correction: Pass 2404 correctly excluded full-symmetry linear maps by irreducibility/dimension, but the sharper carrier statement is that the integral E8 action is naturally a representation of the double cover 2.U4(2), not an ordinary eight-dimensional U4(2) representation.

e8_carrier.faithful_central_action: The central involution acts as -I; otherwise the representation would factor through U4(2).

first_possible_nonzero_level.condition: Restrict to a subgroup whose lift avoids the central involution (for example an odd-order split subgroup) and specify the lift explicitly.
first_possible_nonzero_level.current_result: The central obstruction disappears there, but no canonical first nonzero geometrically distinguished lift is frozen in this packet.

s4_packet.conclusion: The common S4 quotient cannot itself define an E8-to-coexact intertwiner until a splitting/lift is specified.

theorem: The E8/coexact mismatch is a central-character obstruction before it is a dimension obstruction: the faithful integral E8 carrier belongs to 2.U4(2) with z=-1, whereas the coexact 90 is inflated from U4(2) with z=+1. Hence every intertwiner vanishes on every common lifted subgroup containing z, including the full preimage of the residual S4 packet.
